paper.title_en: Universal Theory of Strange and Bad Metals from Spatially Random Interactions with Underdamped Quantum-Critical Bosons
paper.abstract_en: One of the most important challenges in condensed matter physics is understanding the macroscopic properties of strange metals, particularly why their resistivity remains linear in temperature over several decades. We propose that a (2+1)d theory of fermions coupled to underdamped quantum-critical bosons through a spatially disordered interaction provides this long-sought-after theoretical explanation. The key novelty of our work is to establish the appropriate separation of scales so that the bosons are underdamped. Using this framework, we obtain two distinct forms for the fermionic self-energy: a conformal-limit solution, $Σ\sim\sqrtω$, and a marginal Fermi-liquid solution, $Σ\simω\log(1/ω)$, corresponding to regimes above and below the Mott-Ioffe-Regel limit, respectively. These solutions produce Planckian scattering, exhibit exact $T$-linear resistivity, $ω/T$ scaling in the optical conductivity, as well as $\sim T\log(1/T)$ heat capacity at low temperatures. Moreover, our theory naturally unifies strange- and bad-metal phenomena within a single framework, suggesting that we are now approaching a new epoch in understanding the physics of strongly correlated matter.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文针对凝聚态中的奇异金属与劣金属问题，提出费米子通过空间无序相互作用耦合到欠阻尼量子临界玻色子的(2+1)维理论，给出两类费米自能解并解释普朗克散射、T线性电阻率与ω/T标度等输运现象。与全息凝聚态物质主题（强关联、奇异金属）高度契合，理论构造较深入，陈述清晰；虽无全息对偶方法，但主题归属由候选主题证据支持。新近预印本零引用为中性，不影响评分。
decision.title_zh: 来自空间随机相互作用与欠阻尼量子临界玻色子的奇异金属与劣金属普适理论
decision.abstract_zh: 凝聚态物理学中最重要的挑战之一，是理解奇异金属的宏观性质，特别是为何其电阻率在几十个数量级的温度范围内始终保持随温度线性变化。我们提出，一个费米子通过空间无序相互作用与欠阻尼量子临界玻色子耦合的(2+1)维理论，为这一长期寻求的理论解释提供了答案。我们工作的关键新颖之处在于确立了恰当的量纲分离，使玻色子处于欠阻尼状态。利用这一框架，我们得到费米子自能的两种不同形式：共形极限解 $\Sigma\sim\sqrtω$，以及边缘费米液体解 $\Sigma\simω\log(1/ω)$，分别对应于Mott-Ioffe-Regel极限之上和之下的区域。这些解产生普朗克散射，呈现精确的 $T$ 线性电阻率、光电导中的 $ω/T$ 标度，以及低温下 $\sim T\log(1/T)$ 的热容。此外，我们的理论在一个单一框架内自然地统一了奇异金属与劣金属现象，表明我们如今正接近理解强关联物质物理的新纪元。
